before.title: Wire Transfer Operations Standard
before.body_markdown:
# Wire Transfer Operations Standard

## 1. Scope
This standard applies to all domestic and international wire transfers initiated through retail branches and digital channels.

## 2. Dual Control Approval
Any wire transfer above $10,000 requires dual control approval by two authorised staff members. The second approver must not be the initiator of the transfer. Approvals are recorded in the payments platform with both user identifiers.

## 3. Cut-off Times
Domestic wires received before 4:00 PM Eastern are processed the same business day. International wires must be submitted before 2:00 PM Eastern for same-day release.

## 4.2 Audit Log Retention
Wire transfer audit logs must be retained for 7 years in immutable storage. Logs are encrypted with customer-managed keys and access is reviewed quarterly.

before.title: Data Access and Masking Standard
before.body_markdown:
# Data Access and Masking Standard

## 1. Column Masking
Customer identifiers in Silver and Gold tables are masked by default for all analyst roles. Unmasked values are visible only to principals granted the pii_reader role.

## 2. Access Reviews
Data owners must recertify every access grant to restricted tables each quarter. Grants that are not recertified within 14 days of the review deadline are revoked automatically.

## 3. Break-Glass Access
Break-glass production access expires automatically after 4 hours. Every break-glass session must be linked to an incident ticket and reviewed by the platform lead.

before.title: AML Transaction Monitoring Procedure
before.body_markdown:
# AML Transaction Monitoring Procedure

## 1. Alert Triage
Level 1 analysts must disposition every transaction monitoring alert within 10 business days of generation. Alerts that cannot be closed are escalated to a Level 2 investigator.

## 2. Suspicious Activity Report Filing
A suspicious activity report must be filed within 30 calendar days of the initial detection of suspicious activity. The filing deadline may be extended once by 30 days when no suspect is identified.

## 3. Tipping Off
Staff must never disclose to a customer that a suspicious activity report has been filed or is under consideration.

before.title: Production Incident Response Runbook
before.body_markdown:
# Production Incident Response Runbook

## 1. Severity 1 Response
A Severity 1 incident must be acknowledged by the on-call engineer within 15 minutes of the page. The incident commander posts status updates to stakeholders every 30 minutes until resolution.

## 2. Postmortem
A blameless postmortem must be published within 5 business days after a Severity 1 incident is resolved. Each corrective action needs an owner and a due date.
